name: Dynamite Kerbeus
description: The three-headed guardian reborn with dynamite power. Dynamite Kerbeus unleashes the fury of three heads simultaneously — an unstoppable defensive titan that punishes every attack with triple-headed retaliation.

ability.name: Triple Head Retaliation
ability.description: Each successful defense triggers one of Kerbeus's three heads (cycles through): Head 1 heals 25 HP; Head 2 grants a 30 HP shield; Head 3 deals 30 true damage to the attacker. After all three heads activate, Kerbeus enters TRIPLE FURY for 2 turns — all stats +20.

chain._note: Triple Fury: +20 all stats for 2 turns after 3 heads activated

special_move.name: Dynamite Triple Fang
special_move.description: All three heads of Kerbeus strike simultaneously — a three-phase explosive assault that detonates with the force of dynamite!
flavour_texts: 🐕 **Dynamite Triple Fang** — the three heads converge!
